name: Occupational Personality Questionnaire OPQ32r
description: The SHL Occupational Personality Questionnaire (OPQ32r) is one of the most widely used personality assessments in the world. It measures 32 personality characteristics related to workplace behavior and predicts performance, cultural fit, leadership potential, and development needs. Ideal for selection, development, and succession planning across all job levels.

name: Motivation Questionnaire (MQ)
description: The Motivation Questionnaire (MQ) measures 18 motivational dimensions to understand what energizes and drives an individual at work. It identifies motivators and potential de-motivators to improve job fit, engagement, and retention. Widely used in selection, career development, and coaching.

name: RemoteWorkQ
description: The RemoteWorkQ assesses a candidate's suitability and readiness for remote or hybrid work environments. It measures key traits such as self-discipline, communication, adaptability, and technology comfort that predict success in remote work settings.

name: ADEPT-15
description: ADEPT-15 is a personality questionnaire that measures 15 personality traits relevant to workplace behavior. Based on the Big Five personality model, it provides insights into a candidate's interpersonal style, task orientation, and thinking style. Suitable for a wide range of roles and levels.

name: Verify G+ (Numerical, Inductive, Deductive)
description: Verify G+ is SHL's flagship cognitive ability test measuring general mental ability through three sub-tests: Numerical Reasoning, Inductive Reasoning, and Deductive Reasoning. It provides a comprehensive measure of a candidate's ability to learn, adapt, and solve complex problems. Suitable for graduate and professional roles.

name: Verify Interactive G+
description: Verify Interactive G+ is an adaptive version of the G+ test measuring general cognitive ability through interactive questions. It assesses Deductive, Inductive, and Numerical Reasoning using drag-and-drop and interactive question formats. Designed to be engaging while providing accurate measurement of cognitive potential.

name: Verify Numerical Reasoning
description: Measures a candidate's ability to analyze and interpret numerical data presented in tables, graphs, and charts to make logical decisions. Assesses data interpretation, calculation accuracy, and quantitative reasoning. Relevant for roles requiring analysis of financial, statistical, or business data.

name: Verify Numerical Reasoning (Interactive)
description: Interactive version of the Numerical Reasoning test using drag-and-drop and interactive formats to assess data interpretation and quantitative reasoning. Provides a more engaging assessment experience while maintaining measurement accuracy.

name: Verify Verbal Reasoning
description: Measures a candidate's ability to understand, analyze, and evaluate written information. Tests comprehension, logical reasoning from text, and ability to draw conclusions. Critical for roles requiring strong communication, analysis of reports, or working with written information.

name: Verify Verbal Reasoning (Interactive)
description: Interactive version of Verbal Reasoning assessing text comprehension and logical reasoning from written passages. Uses engaging interactive question formats while accurately measuring verbal ability.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning
description: Measures ability to identify patterns, rules, and relationships in abstract information and apply them to solve problems. Assesses logical reasoning, innovative thinking, and ability to deal with novel situations. Valuable for technical, engineering, and analytical roles.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning (Interactive)
description: Interactive version of Inductive Reasoning using engaging question formats to assess abstract pattern recognition and logical reasoning. Ideal for technology and engineering roles.

name: Verify Deductive Reasoning
description: Assesses a candidate's ability to draw logical conclusions from given information and apply rules consistently. Tests logical deduction, attention to detail, and systematic problem-solving. Important for roles in law, compliance, data analysis, and operations.

name: Verify Deductive Reasoning (Interactive)
description: Interactive version of Deductive Reasoning test assessing logical inference and systematic problem-solving using interactive formats.

name: Verify Mechanical Comprehension
description: Measures understanding of mechanical principles, physical laws, and how mechanical devices work. Assesses spatial reasoning, technical aptitude, and practical problem-solving relevant to engineering, manufacturing, and trades roles.

name: Verify Calculation
description: Tests numerical calculation skills including arithmetic, percentages, fractions, and basic algebra. Designed for roles requiring accurate numerical calculations such as bookkeeping, administration, or data entry positions.

name: Verify Checking
description: Measures speed and accuracy in checking and comparing information such as names, codes, and figures. Assesses attention to detail, accuracy, and processing speed. Critical for clerical, administrative, and data entry roles.

name: Verify - Working with Information
description: Measures a candidate's ability to process information presented in table formats, requiring candidates to locate, extract, and use information accurately. Relevant for administrative and data processing roles that require working with structured data.

name: Java 8 (New)
description: Multi-choice test that measures knowledge of Java class design, exceptions, generics, collections, concurrency, JDBC, and Java I/O fundamentals. Suitable for mid to senior Java developers.

name: Core Java (Entry Level) (New)
description: Multi-choice test that measures knowledge of basic Java constructs, OOP concepts, file handling, exception handling, threads, generic class, and inner class. Designed for entry-level Java developers.

name: Core Java (Advanced Level) (New)
description: Multi-choice test measuring advanced Java knowledge including OOP concepts, file and exception handling, generics, advanced Java frameworks, design patterns, and concurrent programming. For experienced Java developers.

name: Python (New)
description: Multi-choice test that measures knowledge of Python programming, databases, modules, and library usage. Covers Python syntax, data structures, OOP in Python, file handling, and common libraries. Suitable for Python developers at intermediate level.

name: C Programming (New)
description: Multi-choice test measuring knowledge of C programming language including pointers, memory management, data structures, file I/O, and system programming concepts.

name: C++ (New)
description: Multi-choice test measuring knowledge of C++ including object-oriented programming, templates, STL, memory management, and advanced C++ features. For C++ developers in systems, games, or embedded contexts.

name: JavaScript (New)
description: Multi-choice test measuring JavaScript knowledge including ES6+, DOM manipulation, asynchronous programming, closures, prototypes, and common patterns. Suitable for front-end and full-stack developers.

name: SQL (New)
description: Measures knowledge of SQL including queries, joins, aggregations, subqueries, stored procedures, and database design concepts. Relevant for developers, data analysts, and database administrators.

name: .NET Framework 4.5
description: Measures knowledge of .NET Framework 4.5 including C#, ASP.NET, WPF, Entity Framework, LINQ, and related Microsoft technologies. Suitable for .NET and C# developers.

name: HTML/CSS (New)
description: Multi-choice test assessing knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3 including semantic markup, CSS layout, responsive design, and web standards. For front-end developers and web designers.

name: PHP (New)
description: Assesses PHP programming knowledge including syntax, object-oriented PHP, database interaction, session management, and common PHP frameworks. For PHP web developers.

name: R (New)
description: Multi-choice test measuring knowledge of R programming for statistical analysis, data manipulation, visualization, and machine learning. Suitable for data scientists and statisticians.

name: Scala (New)
description: Tests knowledge of Scala programming language including functional programming, Akka, Spark, and JVM ecosystem. Relevant for big data and distributed systems developers.

name: Microsoft Excel (New)
description: Tests proficiency in Microsoft Excel including formulas, functions, pivot tables, charts, data analysis tools, and macros. Suitable for roles requiring spreadsheet and data analysis skills.

name: Microsoft Word (New)
description: Assesses proficiency in Microsoft Word including document formatting, styles, tables, mail merge, and collaboration features. Relevant for administrative, legal, and office roles.

name: Microsoft PowerPoint (New)
description: Tests proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint including creating presentations, animations, slide design, and presentation delivery. For roles requiring presentation and communication skills.

name: General Mental Ability Test (GMAT)
description: A broad measure of cognitive ability assessing verbal, numerical, and abstract reasoning. Provides a quick overall measure of general intelligence applicable across many job roles.

name: Situational Judgement Test - Customer Service
description: A situational judgement test presenting realistic customer service scenarios. Candidates choose the most and least effective responses, measuring customer service orientation, problem resolution, and communication skills.

name: Situational Judgement Test - Management
description: Presents management and leadership scenarios to measure decision-making, team management, conflict resolution, and leadership effectiveness. Suitable for frontline to senior managers.

name: Graduate and Managerial Assessment (GMA) Numerical
description: Numerical reasoning assessment designed for graduate and managerial level candidates. Measures ability to interpret and use numerical data in a business context.

name: Graduate and Managerial Assessment (GMA) Verbal
description: Verbal reasoning assessment for graduates and managers measuring comprehension, logical reasoning from written information, and ability to evaluate arguments.

name: Graduate and Managerial Assessment (GMA) Abstract
description: Abstract reasoning assessment for graduates and managers measuring ability to identify patterns and relationships in abstract information, assessing potential to learn quickly.

name: Customer Service Simulation
description: A realistic job simulation for customer service roles, presenting candidates with realistic interactions including emails, calls, and chat scenarios. Measures empathy, problem-solving, communication skills, and customer orientation.

name: Technology Professional Job Focused Assessment
description: A comprehensive job-focused assessment for technology professionals measuring cognitive ability, personality traits relevant to tech roles, and work style. Covers critical thinking, innovation, collaboration, and technical orientation.

name: Coding Simulation (Python)
description: A hands-on coding simulation where candidates write actual Python code to solve real-world programming challenges. Evaluates coding ability, problem-solving approach, code quality, and debugging skills. Ideal for software developer recruitment.

name: Coding Simulation (Java)
description: Hands-on Java coding simulation presenting real programming challenges to assess Java coding ability, object-oriented design, problem-solving, and code quality. For Java developer recruitment.

name: 360 Digital Report
description: An online 360-degree feedback report gathering multi-rater data on an individual's competencies and behaviors. Provides a comprehensive view of performance from peers, managers, and direct reports to support development planning.

name: 360° Multi-Rater Feedback System (MFS)
description: Comprehensive multi-rater feedback system collecting structured feedback from multiple sources (self, manager, peers, direct reports). Supports individual development, team building, and succession planning with rich competency-based reports.

name: OPQ User Report
description: This OPQ report includes a Profile Chart and narrative text focusing on an individual's likely way of behaving at work. Used as an interpretation aid for feedback, writing reports, or interpreting OPQ results. Suitable for a wide range of job levels.

name: OPQ Leadership Report
description: OPQ report providing detailed analysis of leadership potential based on SHL's Leadership Model. Offers a competency-based approach to assess leadership strengths and development areas. Relevant for managers and executives.

name: OPQ Manager Plus Report
description: Concise OPQ report designed for use with and by managers. Uses clear bullet points and tables for easy interpretation, providing commentary on personality traits relevant to managerial performance.

name: OPQ Universal Competency Report
description: OPQ report based on the Universal Competency Framework, graphically outlining how personality is likely to impact competencies. Provides scales for each competency with personality contribution analysis. For competency-based selection and development.

name: OPQ Premium Plus Report
description: Comprehensive OPQ report bundle including profile, user report, manager plus report, candidate report, universal competency report, and team impact selection report. Provides a complete personality assessment package.

name: Filing - Names (R1)
description: Measures ability to sort names in alphabetical order. Test takers see graphical folder tabs and must identify correct alphabetical filing positions. Assesses clerical speed and accuracy for administrative roles.

name: Typing (W1)
description: Measures typing speed and accuracy. Candidates transcribe a passage of text with a score given for both words per minute and accuracy. Essential for data entry, administrative, and secretarial roles.

name: Numerical Ability (MQ)
description: Tests basic numerical skills including number sequences, fractions, percentages, and arithmetic operations. Designed for entry-level and operational roles requiring basic numeracy.

name: Verbal Ability (WA2)
description: Measures basic verbal skills including word meanings, grammar, and sentence completion. Suitable for entry-level and operational roles requiring basic communication and literacy skills.

name: Technology Job Focused Assessment
description: A focused assessment measuring technical aptitude and thinking style relevant to technology roles. Combines reasoning ability measures with work style assessment for IT and software professionals.

name: Salesforce Platform Developer
description: Measures knowledge of Salesforce development including Apex, Visualforce, Lightning components, SOQL, and Salesforce platform configuration. For Salesforce developers and CRM specialists.

name: AWS Cloud Practitioner
description: Assesses foundational knowledge of Amazon Web Services including cloud concepts, core services, security, billing, and pricing. Suitable for cloud practitioners and developers using AWS.

name: Agile Methodology
description: Tests understanding of Agile principles, Scrum framework, Kanban, sprint planning, retrospectives, and Agile best practices. For software teams, product managers, and project managers working in Agile environments.

name: Data Analysis (New)
description: Multi-choice test assessing knowledge of data analysis concepts, statistical methods, data visualization, and interpretation of analytical results. For data analysts and business analysts.

name: Accounting Fundamentals
description: Tests knowledge of fundamental accounting concepts including double-entry bookkeeping, financial statements, accounts payable/receivable, and basic financial reporting. For accounting and finance roles.

name: Project Manager (Intermediate Level)
description: Assesses project management knowledge and skills including planning, scheduling, risk management, stakeholder management, and project lifecycle. For project managers at intermediate experience level.

name: CompTIA Security+
description: Measures cybersecurity knowledge aligned with CompTIA Security+ including network security, cryptography, identity management, threats, vulnerabilities, and security operations.

name: Call Center Solution
description: Comprehensive assessment solution for call center roles measuring customer service orientation, verbal communication, attention to detail, numerical ability, and personality fit for contact center environments.

name: Business Analyst (New)
description: Tests knowledge of business analysis methodologies, requirements elicitation, process modeling, stakeholder management, and BA best practices. For business analysts working on technology or process improvement projects.

name: Workplace Safety Inventory
description: Measures attitudes and behaviors related to workplace safety, risk-taking tendencies, and adherence to safety procedures. Identifies candidates likely to engage in safe workplace behaviors and follow safety protocols.

name: Graduate SJT
description: A situational judgement test designed specifically for graduate-level candidates, presenting workplace scenarios to measure judgment, professional competencies, decision-making, and organizational effectiveness.

name: Cognitive Ability Test - Standard (CATS)
description: A comprehensive cognitive battery assessing verbal, numerical, and spatial/mechanical reasoning. Provides a thorough assessment of cognitive ability across multiple dimensions for selection and development.
